items.front: Little's law: average items in a system equal what?

back.text: Their arrival rate times the average time each spends inside (L = λW).

items.front: What must be true of a system for Little's law to hold?

back.text: It must be stable: on average, items leave as fast as they arrive.

items.front: How do you forecast an item's time in the system from Little's law?

back.text: Divide work in progress by throughput.

items.front: A team has 30 items in progress and finishes 10 a week. How long should a new item take?
At the same throughput, what does doubling work in progress do to waiting time?

back.text: It doubles it: waits grow in exactly the same proportion as work in progress.
